segments.text: Hey Telegram, we have a situation here.
When we send a big and long story in a voice message,
we want to play it and know every single timeline in it.
We need access to a summary or something like that
to improve it and get the results in a short time.
That helps us have a better experience responding to long voice messages.
When we send long voice messages, users can use this feature
to access summaries and timelines and make a better response
to long voice messages in less time.
